card.name: Spaces before section number 4 references
card.fires_on: The space or open parenthesis just before the section number 4 in label cross-references such as (4) after Contraindications. It also fires on a few commas that close an inserted phrase.

modes.label: Contraindications cross-reference
modes.description: The space or bracket right before the number 4 when pointing to the Contraindications section.
modes.example: is contraindicated in patients with a history of hypersensitivity reactions to Glatiramer acetate injection, including anaphylaxis (<< >>4 ).

modes.label: Comma after inserted list or clause
modes.description: A comma in ordinary prose that ends an inserted phrase before the main clause continues.
modes.example: including vegetarians, Jews, and Muslims<<,>> would be interested to know.
